summary: Sysco Corporation filed an 8-K reporting entry into a First Amendment to its Revolving Credit Agreement, establishing a $750 million senior unsecured delayed draw term loan facility with CoBank and Bank of America as administrative agent. The facility comprises two tranches—$375 million six-year and $375 million eight-year—available for draws over one year. Proceeds will fund general corporate purposes, partly to pay cash consideration for the previously announced JRD Unico acquisition. Item 5.02 references an officer departure or appointment, but details are not provided. This is a routine financing event, not a special situation requiring classification.
